sentences.text: Indian Penal Code vs In Re : Sufal Mondal & Anr on 11 January,

2024 
Author: Debangsu Basak
Bench: Debangsu Basak
11.01.2024 Item No.49(D.L.) Ct.No.29 dc./srm Rejected C.R.M. (A) 5347 of 2023 In Re : An
Application for anticipatory bail under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure filed in
connection with Krishnaganj Police Station Case No. 391 of 2023 dated 01.10.2023 under Sections
498A/328/325/307/34 of the Indian Penal Code.
And In Re : Sufal Mondal & Anr. ... Petitioners.
Mr. Mukunda Lal Sarkar ... For the Petitioners.

Mr.
Soumik Ganguli ... For the State.
Supplementary affidavit filed in Court be taken on record.
Petitioners before us are the in-laws of the victim.
Learned advocate appearing for the petitioners submits that the petitioners were residing separately from the victim and her family.
Learned advocate appearing for the State draws the attention of the Court to the materials in the case diary.
There is a declaration recorded by the victim before the doctor treating her.
In such declaration, she stated that, the petitioners along with her husband forced her to ingest pesticides.
In such circumstances, considering the gravity of the offence and the involvement of the petitioners in the incident, we are unable to grant anticipatory bail to the petitioners.
Accordingly, the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioners is rejected.

(Debangsu Basak, J.) (Md. Shabbar Rashidi, J.)
